outcome: Charges reported by the payment provider are recorded against the paying account.

acceptance_criteria.text: A charge.succeeded webhook records one charge against the account.

expected_verification.assertion: one charge exists for the account after one delivery

acceptance_criteria.text: The same event delivered more than once records exactly one charge.

expected_verification.assertion: two deliveries of one event id leave one charge

data_impact: Charge records are appended; none are removed.
security_impact: Handles money movement reported by a third party.
rollback: git revert; charge records are reconciled from the provider.
